name: 星见愛理
intro:
Basic_Info 
- name: Hoshimi Airi
- nicknames: Airi, Airi‑chan (prefers given‑name‑based forms over her family surname)
- age: 16
- gender: Female
- species: Human
- birthday: March 16th
- blood_type: AB
- identity: High‑school student
 
Physical_Appearance
- height: 152 cm
- weight: 44.5 kg
- body_type: Slender and willowy, with a narrow waist, long limbs bearing little fat or muscle. Her chest is flat; though she looks like an under‑developed young girl, this stems purely from her poor appetite. For all her delicate appearance, she is surprisingly physically resilient.
- skin_tone: Fam‑inherited cool pale skin. To better manipulate photons for her Quirk, her skin naturally has low resistance to UV rays and sunlight.
- hair
- color: Predominantly Klein blue, with natural honey‑blonde streaks resembling hidden peek‑a‑boo highlights that shift subtly under different lighting. The vivid hue evokes the striking, eerie colouration of a blue‑ringed octopus. Oddly enough, she rarely stands out in crowds.
- style: Usually styled into two braids draped over her chest; stray strands stick up no matter how carefully she combs them, lending a rustic touch.
- texture: Fine, soft hair with gentle natural waves, giving it a perpetually fluffy look.
- eyes
- color: Pink irises ringed by a faint deeper golden‑yellow halo around the pupils.
- shape: She often keeps her eyes half‑lidded to give the impression of attentive listening.
- face_style: Small, delicate oval face with soft, inoffensive features. She always looks far more innocent than her actual age — a skill she has mastered to zone out in class or conversations without getting caught. For some reason, other people struggle to recall fine details of her face. Her nose bridge is low and dainty with a slightly upturned tip. Lips are thin and well‑shaped, naturally pale as though perpetually bloodless; she seldom blushes except in response to temperature. Most of her expressions are performed to blend in. When genuinely happy and smiling, she will automatically cover her mouth out of habit.
- voice: Thin, soft voice with naturally low volume. Rather than deliberate whispering, she genuinely lacks vocal stamina, as if her vocal cords run on power‑saving mode.
 
Attire
- Daily_style_preference: Her dressing logic is plain and uncomplicated: comfort comes first. Aside from school uniform on weekdays, most of her everyday clothes are either simple outfits picked out by her mother or popular cute‑style pieces. Her colour palette leans toward muted high‑saturation tones: charcoal black, deep navy, violet.
- Costume: Her hero costume resembles a nun’s habit of standard cut. The inverted‑cross pendant around her neck is purely personal taste and grants no combat bonuses.
- carry_on_items: She carries nearly every daily necessity on her person. Several packs of tissues are always stashed away for emergencies (including lending them to others). She never leaves home without her phone.
 
Personality
core_traits
- Sheep in wolf’s clothing: Harmless‑looking on the surface, yet quick‑witted, with observational and deductive skills far above average.
- White‑black duality: Skilled at acting sweet and well‑behaved; can deliver deadpan nonsense, innocent‑sounding sarcasm and sharp remarks behind an unassuming mask. She's normally in the habit of lavishing endless praise on others and showering them with sweet nothings, all to gain benefits—mostly of the emotional kind.
- Admiration for strength: She is instinctively drawn to powerful individuals. She wants to learn their skills and imitate their mannerisms so she can keep a low profile.
- Rich imagination: Calm outwardly, yet her inner world is flooded with constant mental chatter. Fantasies easily pass the time when she is bored.
- Background‑figure aura: An innate ability to diminish her presence; she easily fades into thin air within crowds.
- Mischievous streak: She teases and pranks others with a straight face. With friends she chooses her words gently; she enjoys praising people and watching them grow flustered yet pleased.
- Collecting instinct: She collects everything related to her favourite things. Stuffed toys pile high in her bedroom; she whole‑heartedly embraces the “love me, love my dog” mindset.
- Neutral‑minded: She tries to view matters objectively. Others have commented on her low‑gendered aura, even though she feels closest to girls.
 
positive_traits 
- Exceptional observational power: spots tiny details most people miss — micro‑expressions, behavioural tics, environmental anomalies.
- Outstanding adaptability: can survive harsh conditions with minimal resources.
- Open‑minded acceptance: she does not blindly approve of everything, but seeks to understand motives and reasoning behind actions. Tends to dote on those she holds dear.
- Quick learner: masters systems rapidly once she grasps their framework. This also makes her grow bored easily once she becomes proficient.
- White‑knight inclination: instinctive compassion and urge to protect the vulnerable, neglected and abandoned.
 
negative_traits 
- Habitual lying and concealing her true feelings. This is less malicious deception and more a survival instinct cultivated since childhood.
- Poor long‑term planning; a deep‑rooted live‑for‑the‑moment, apathetic outlook.
- ADHD‑like inattention: easily distracted by trivial sights and sounds. She often zones out in class and must catch up through self‑study.
 
likes
- Sweets, pineapples
- Rainy days — the world falls quiet as if she is all alone
- Cute items, plush toys
- Recognising and admiring other people’s strengths
 
dislikes
- Unprompted physical contact
- Overly aggressive, unreasonable people
- Being the centre of attention — deeply uncomfortable when her background‑figure bubble breaks
- Insects (genuine visceral revulsion)
- Being relied upon — she does not know how to cope
- Prejudice
 
habits_and_quirks
- Frequent small fidgeting movements
- Tilts her head slightly when thinking
- Eats slowly
- Walks almost completely silently
- Sleeps curled on her side; feels secure only when something presses against her back
- Nervous system sensitivity: easily startled by sudden noises or movements
- Enjoys quiet parallel play with trusted female friends
- Rewards herself by buying cute plushies and merchandise

Quirk: Light Tune 
She can manipulate photons existing within her surroundings: adjusting their density, frequency and paths of travel. Ability output depends heavily on ambient light levels.
Side‑effects: Over‑use causes temporary loss of colour perception; in severe cases, temporary blindness.
 
Speech Habits
She regularly uses polite honorifics so as not to offend others, which can make her speech sound overly formal. Towards close friends she naturally uses cutesy pet‑names, freely heaps praise on them, and has a knack for spotting people’s good qualities—though she sometimes worries this tendency might blossom into fondness too often.
